name: @iflow-mcp/sonpiaz-hidrix-tools

tools.name: content_analyzer
tools.description: Analyze posts for topic clusters, content patterns, posting time trends, and author leaderboard. Input: JSON array of posts. No external API needed.

posts_json.description: JSON array of post objects with fields: text, author, url, timestamp, reactions, comments, shares

analysis_type.description: Type of analysis: full (all), topics, patterns, or trends

tools.name: content_scorer
tools.description: Score and rank posts by weighted engagement (reactions, comments, shares) with time-decay. Input: JSON array of posts. Output: top N ranked posts with scores.

posts_json.description: JSON array of post objects with fields: text, author, url, timestamp, reactions, comments, shares

tools.name: data_store
tools.description: Save and query scraped posts from persistent SQLite storage. Actions: save (store posts, auto-dedup), query (search stored posts), stats (storage overview), recent (run history). Use after scraping to build a knowledge base that persists across sessions.

action.description: Action: save, query, stats, or recent

posts_json.description: JSON array of posts (for save action)

platform.description: Filter by platform: x, reddit, facebook, linkedin (for query)

source.description: Filter by source URL or name (for query)

since.description: Only posts scraped after this date, e.g. 2024-01-01 (for query)

tools.name: facebook_scraper
tools.description: Scrape Facebook content from groups, pages, keyword search, or ads library. Modes: group (public FB groups), page (FB page posts), search (keyword search), ads (Meta Ad Library, free). Returns posts sorted by engagement score with reactions, comments, shares.

source_type.description: What to scrape: group, page, search, or ads

targets.description: Comma-separated targets. For group: group URLs. For page: page URLs or names. For search: keywords. For ads: search keywords.

since.description: Only posts newer than this date, e.g. 2024-01-01 (group mode only)

countries.description: Comma-separated country codes for ads mode, e.g. US,VN

page_ids.description: Comma-separated Facebook page IDs (ads mode only)

tools.name: reddit_subreddit_top
tools.description: Get top posts from a specific subreddit. Filter by time range (day, week, month, year, all) and sort order. Uses Reddit's free public JSON API — no API key needed.

tools.name: reddit_thread_reader
tools.description: Read a full Reddit post with comment tree. Shows post content, engagement stats, and threaded comments with scores. Uses Reddit's free public JSON API — no API key needed.

tools.name: web_fetch
tools.description: Fetch a URL and extract readable content as markdown. Extracts metadata (author, date, tags, reading time). Handles X/Twitter URLs specially (shows tweet with engagement). Optional JS rendering for SPA/paywalled pages (requires APIFY_API_TOKEN).

extract_metadata.description: Extract author, date, tags, reading time

js_render.description: Use headless browser for JS-rendered pages (requires APIFY_API_TOKEN)

tools.name: x_search
tools.description: Search X/Twitter posts with full engagement data (likes, retweets, replies, views). Supports advanced operators: from:user, min_faves:100, since:2024-01-01, filter:links, etc. Results sorted by Top or Latest.

query.description: Search query. Supports advanced operators: from:user, to:user, min_faves:100, min_retweets:50, since:YYYY-MM-DD, until:YYYY-MM-DD, lang:en, filter:links, -filter:replies

tools.name: youtube_channel
tools.description: Browse YouTube channel — latest videos, search within channel, or list all videos. Modes: latest (free, newest 15 uploads), search (find videos in channel by keyword), all (paginated full list).

channel.description: YouTube channel (@handle, URL, or channel ID)

query.description: Search query within channel (for search mode)

tools.name: youtube_transcript
tools.description: Extract transcript from any YouTube video — turns video into readable text. Essential for learning from videos without watching them. Supports timestamps. Works with TranscriptAPI or free Python lib.

video.description: YouTube video URL or video ID
